verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no natural-language command interface inside Elasticsearch itself. There is no assistant or NL-to-query feature, and the product is operated through Query DSL, ES|QL, KQL and client libraries. The official MCP server and the agent skills only let external AI agents drive Elasticsearch. Those are separate integration stories and building blocks, not the product's own natural-language operation, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
